text:
Predicates:
LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
NaturalLanguageProcessingTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Premises:
∀x (NaturalLanguageProcessingTask(x) → (LanguageGenerationTask(x) ∨ LanguageUnderstandingTask(x))) ::: Tasks are either language generation or understanding.
∀x (OutputIsTextSequence(x) ∧ NaturalLanguageProcessingTask(x) → LanguageGenerationTask(x)) ::: If the output of a NLP task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
MachineTranslation(x) → LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: Machine translation is a language generation task.
